summary: Bounded retry/dead-letter decision seam for broker/gRPC protocol transport execution.
claim_boundary: Retry decision seam only. This slice executes already-planned broker/gRPC transport bundles through an injected retry executor with explicit retryable/permanent attempt classification and capped planned backoff. It performs no live broker publish, gRPC network call, async sleep, process supervision, deployment, or delivery guarantee.

facets.F1_simplicity: A small app crate owns retry/dead-letter decisions over the existing protocol transport kernel instead of mixing retry state into REST, gRPC, outbox, or domain crates.
facets.F2_hyperscaler: Bounded attempts, capped backoff planning, immediate permanent-error stop, and final execution reports prepare later horizontally scaled transport workers for predictable failure handling.
facets.F3_adversarial: Tests cover invalid policy, retryable errors followed by success, attempts exhaustion without terminal backoff, permanent errors stopping without retry, and kernel executor adapter success/permanent-invariant behavior.
facets.F4_api_contract: The public surface adds ProtocolTransportRetryPolicy, ProtocolTransportRetryExecutor, ProtocolTransportAttemptError, attempt/run reports, stop reasons, planned_retry_backoff_ms, KernelProtocolTransportRetryExecutor, and execute_protocol_transport_with_retry.
facets.F5_quality: Focused retry-app tests plus the 42-package backbone check/test/clippy/fmt matrix, cargo-deny, license-policy, cargo-prefix, catalog/data-class known-blocker probes, parse/config validation, dependency-seam, honest-claims, and diff hygiene are part of this run.
facets.F6_operations: Retry run reports expose stop reason, per-attempt outcome, planned backoff, error refs, acknowledgement sequence, and final transport report for future worker telemetry and dead-letter routing.
facets.F7_security_privacy: Reports carry operational refs and acknowledgement sequence only; the crate does not store payload bodies, raw message/mail/post content, credentials, broker URLs, database URLs, or principal secrets.
facets.F8_supply_chain: No new third-party dependency is introduced; the app depends only on existing workspace protocol transport/parity crates.
facets.F9_testing: Focused tests passed for 7 retry-app tests and the broad backbone matrix passed 265 unit tests plus the existing ignored metrics adapter doctest.
facets.F10_ci_cd: GitHub Actions and all four Jenkins package matrices include the retry app, preserving Jenkins/GitHub Actions parity doctrine without claiming remote CI execution.
facets.F11_observability: Per-attempt reports provide retry outcome and planned backoff evidence that can later bind to retry-budget, backpressure, and dead-letter metrics.
facets.F13_reversibility: The slice is isolated to one app crate plus catalog/workspace/CI/task/evidence wiring; removing it leaves protocol planning, recording acknowledgements, outbox dispatch, and service-loop seams intact.
